planesPage.heroTitle: Free for clients. Cheap for providers.
planesPage.heroSubtitle: 0% commission on your sales. No contracts. Cancel anytime.
planesPage.whySubtitle: What stays in your pocket after each job, compared.
planesPage.compAlibabaExample: If you bill S/2,000 a month, S/300 to S/600 goes to commissions alone.
planesPage.compMarkaruPrice: S/120 to S/330 a year. 0% commission.
planesPage.compMarkaruExample: At that same billing you pay S/27 a month at most, and the rest is yours.
planesPage.compOtherPrice: You pay to stand out, with no idea if it works
planesPage.compOtherExample: No profile, no reputation and no way for people to find you again.
planesPage.faq1a: Yes, there are no contracts. Cancel anytime from your account.
planesPage.faq2q: Do you charge commission on my sales?
planesPage.faq2a: No. Apurape doesn't touch what you charge: you agree the price with your client and keep all of it. The only thing you pay is the annual membership, and only if you're a provider.
planesPage.faq3q: How much does it cost for clients?
planesPage.faq3a: Nothing. Posting requests, getting quotes, hiring and rating is always free.
planesPage.faq4a: Yes. As a provider your first month is free, and when you subscribe we add another month. If you don't continue, your account stays on the Basic plan with limited quotes.
planesPage.faq5q: What's the difference between Individual and Business?
planesPage.faq5a: Only the price and the raffle: S/120 a year for an individual, S/330 for a business. Monthly raffles are split between the two so you compete with your peers.
planesPage.ctaSubtitle: Join the first providers on Apurape. Start free today.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From the need to the job done, in four steps.

01.title: Tell us what you need
01.description: Post your request in a minute, or browse providers in your district directly.

02.title: Get quotes
02.description: Providers message you with their price, what's included and how long it takes.

03.title: Choose and agree
03.description: Compare, ask whatever you need and accept the one that suits you. The service gets scheduled.

04.title: Confirm and rate
04.description: When the job is done, you confirm it and leave your rating. That confirmation is what counts.

products.title: Everything you can solve on Apurape
products.subtitle: Eight categories and counting. Search for yours.

producerStory.title: Your reputation is built job by job
producerStory.body: On Apurape you don't compete on price against strangers. Every service a client confirms stays on your profile, and only the client's confirmation counts. That makes reputation hard to fake and easy to trust.
producerStory.point1: 0% commission: you keep everything you agree
producerStory.point2: Only the client confirms the job, nobody else
producerStory.point3: Monthly raffle among the best-rated providers

export.title: The monthly raffle: doing good work pays off
export.body: Every month we run a raffle among providers with confirmed sales and at least three five-star ratings, split by category and account type. The winner comes out of an automatic ranking, not a vote and not a favour.
export.point1: You enter with your confirmed sales for the month
export.point3: Split by category: you compete with your peers
export.point4: Clients get their own raffle too

about.title: About Apurape
about.subtitle: You help me, I help you
about.intro: A place to find someone who can sort something out for you, and where good work gets noticed.

meaning.title: What Apurape means
meaning.body: [PENDING — the real origin of the name is missing. Write here where 'Apurape' comes from and why it was chosen.] In the meantime, what does define the platform is its slogan: you help me, I help you. A network where everyone is, at some point, both.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: That anyone in Peru can quickly find someone they trust for what they need, and that whoever offers a service can make a living from their trade without giving away part of every job in commissions. That's why we charge 0% on your sales.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.body: Finding a good plumber, photographer or private tutor still depends on who you know. Neighbourhood groups and classified ads leave no trace: no profile, no reputation and no way to find someone again who did good work. Apurape brings services, quotes and ratings together in one place, with one clear rule: reputation is built only from jobs the client confirmed.
